# Lucacelli Cloud Data Engineering (@lucacelli on Apify Store)
> High-speed Pay-Per-Result Cloud Scrapers & B2B Lead Enrichment APIs ($0.50 to $1.50 per 1,000 results) with native n8n, Make.com, Python, Node.js, and Claude MCP support.
